# fw corpus

> Reference of the fw corpus command: Polite incremental corpus of Google design, Android, Chromium, GitHub, Kotlin, Rust and Cargo docs in per-source SQLite…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/corpus/

Polite incremental corpus of Google design, Android, Chromium, GitHub, Kotlin, Rust and Cargo docs in per-source SQLite FTS5 stores; `fw learn search` includes it

## Usage

```bash
fw corpus <sources|status|sync|search|read|systemd> [--root <dir>]
```

## Subcommands

```bash
fw corpus sources
fw corpus status
fw corpus sync
fw corpus search
fw corpus read
fw corpus systemd
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Flags

| Flag | Argument |
|---|---|
| `--root` | `<dir>` |
